title: P1 world portal response
description: The receipt of one map transition. result carries where the character now is, which the server chose, plus what the transition cleared: pending casts and reserved counters and whether a guard window was open. DEC-TUTORIAL-TRANSPORT-20261106 requires that cleanup to happen on a map change and requires a replay to answer history rather than pull a character back, so replayed receipts keep the destination of the original command while the character stands wherever it has since travelled. Requests refused before the session resolves omit sessionId and result. portal_locked is a valid answer, not an error to hide: it means the chapter grant from the P00-05 turn-in has not been earned yet.

mapId.description: The destination the registry owns. Never echoed from the request, because the request cannot name one.

replayed.description: True when this receipt answers a previously committed command. A replay does not move anybody: applied and the destination stay as the original recorded them.

eventId.description: Deterministic over character, portalId and destination map, so a replayed receipt carries the same id and a different character using the same portal does not.

inflightCastsCancelled.description: Counted from the events the engine actually emitted for this transition, not claimed.

guardWindowClosed.description: True only when a window was open at the moment the transition closed it.
